title: Most common flag colors
content: Steve Faeembracreated this infographic to show which international flag colors are the most popular.Red, white, and blue and not only the most popular individual colors, but they're also the most popular colors in combination with each other. According to Wikipedia, there are over 30 countries and territories with red, white, and blue flags:AustraliaCambodiaChileCook IslandsCosta RicaCubaCroatiaCzech RepublicDominican RepublicFaroe IslandsFijiFranceIcelandLaosLiberiaLuxembourgNepalNetherlandsNew ZealandNorth KoreaNorwayPanamaParaguayPuerto RicoRussiaSamoaSint MaartenSlovakiaSloveniaTaiwanThailandUnited KingdomUnited StatesviaGeekosystemWikipedia:List of countries by colors of national flags
